rubric_v2.built: C4626 Whisper, from Ember C4123 spot-check flags; Ember adversarial pass requested
rubric_v2.R1_status_granularity: status tracks the HEADLINE claim at its ORIGINAL granularity. Direction-level corroboration of a magnitude claim (the F57 ambiguity) does NOT flip status to CONFIRMED — it goes in subclaims[].
rubric_v2.R2_subclaims: optional subclaims[] = [{claim, status, evidence}] records partial adjudication (the F62 flag: one-row-per-finding hid sub-claim results). Subclaims use the same status vocabulary; they feed the audit as a separate informational count, never the headline survival rate.
rubric_v2.R3_evidence_pointers: evidence pointers must reference STABLE artifacts (findings/, results/, prereg files) — never mutable synthesis docs (the F76 flag, fixed C4594).
rubric_v2.R4_retest_definition: retested=true requires a SECOND measurement or formal adjudication event; internal cross-instance checks within one prereg count (Finding 13 precedent); corroboration-by-composition does not.
rubric_v2.R5_composition_status: Ember C4131 finding 2: subclaims whose evidence is corroboration-by-composition (byproducts of experiments designed for other questions) use CORROBORATED_BY_COMPOSITION — a distinct status, weaker than CONFIRMED_ON_RETEST, consistent with R4. It counts in the informational subclaim tally, never as a retest.
